;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Volkmarsen ramming attack]]
**Nearly 60 people are injured when a car [[vehicle-ramming attack|rams]] civilians at a carnival parade in [[Volkmarsen]], [[Hesse]], [[Germany]]. A 29-year-old German national is arrested by police. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-51626844 (BBC News)]
* [[Gaza–Israel conflict]], [[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
** [[Israel]]i [[Prime Minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] threatens the [[Governance of the Gaza Strip|leadership]] of the [[Gaza Strip]] with war if [[Palestinian rocket attacks on Israel|rocket attacks continue]]. [https://www.news.com.au/world/breaking-news/netanyahu-threatens-war-after-rockets-land/news-story/07fe35a38397699f6a61c8ded7dcdd44 (News AU)]
*[[Second Libyan Civil War]], [[Libyan peace process]]
**Both of [[Libya]]'s rival governments, the [[Government of National Accord]] and [[Tobruk]]-based [[House of Representatives (Libya)|House of Representatives]], pull out of [[United Nations|UN]]-sponsored peace talks in [[Geneva]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/eastern-libya-legislators-pull-geneva-peace-talks-200224160824800.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[North East Delhi riots]]
**Violent clashes in [[New Delhi]], [[India]], between [[Hinduism in India|Hindu]] and [[Islam in India|Muslim]] protestors over the [[Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 2019|Citizenship Amendment Act]] during [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s visit leave 13 people dead and at least 150 injured. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/feb/25/delhi-rocked-by-deadly-protests-during-donald-trumps-india-visit (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2020 Toronto machete attack]]
**A 17-year-old boy is arrested and charged with first-degree murder after stabbing two women, one of them fatally, at a massage parlor in [[Toronto]], [[Ontario]], Canada. [https://globalnews.ca/news/6595156/ashley-noell-arzaga-murder-charges-laid/ (Global News)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**The [[Dow Jones Industrial Average]] drops more than 3% as the coronavirus pandemic spreads outside [[China]]. This follows benchmark [[Stock market index|indices]] falling sharply in Europe after steep declines across Asia. [https://www.barrons.com/articles/the-dow-is-down-700-points-as-the-coronavirus-spreads-in-europe-51582548023 (''Barrons'')] [https://www.wsj.com/articles/stocks-fall-as-coronavirus-spread-accelerates-outside-china-11582533308 (''Wall Street Journal'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
***[[Armenia]] has closed its border from [[Meghri]] with [[Iran]] and suspended all flights from Armenia to Iran for the next two weeks due to increasing cases of coronavirus in Iran. [https://www.facebook.com/1378368079150250/posts/2563933197260393/?d=n (Prime Minister of Armenia's Facebook page)]
***The General Authority of [[Oman]]'s Civil Aviation announced the suspension of all flights between the sultanate and the [[Iran|Islamic Republic of Iran]] until further notice. [https://edition.cnn.com/asia/live-news/coronavirus-outbreak-02-24-20-hnk-intl/index.html (CNN)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
***Seventy-four more coronavirus cases are confirmed in [[Italy]], bringing the number to 229. Four more virus-related deaths are confirmed, bringing the death toll to seven. [https://www.repubblica.it/cronaca/2020/02/24/news/coronavirus_149_i_casi_confermati_conte_i_contagi_possono_crescere_-249427098/ (''La Repubblica'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
***Vietnamese airline [[Bamboo Airways]] suspends flights to [[South Korea]] starting February 26. [https://edition.cnn.com/asia/live-news/coronavirus-outbreak-02-24-20-hnk-intl/index.html (CNN)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***The total number of infected in the United States is now 53 people, up from 34 two days ago. [https://www.cnn.com/asia/live-news/coronavirus-outbreak-02-24-20-hnk-intl/index.html (CNN)]
**[[Pakistan International Airlines]] suspends flights to China until March 15. [https://www.geo.tv/latest/273953-pia-suspends-flight-operation-to-beijing-till-march-15 (Geo News)]
**A 300-bed [[isolation ward]] has been set up in [[Islamabad]] for [[Chinese people in Pakistan|Chinese]] citizens returning to Pakistan after vacations. [https://arynews.tv/en/coronavirus-threat-isolation-wards-chinese-pakistan/ (ARY News)]
**[[Kuwait]], [[Iraq]], [[Afghanistan]], [[Oman]] and [[Bahrain]] confirm their first cases of coronavirus. [https://gulfnews.com/world/gulf/bahrain/bahrain-and-kuwait-confirm-first-cases-of-coronavirus-disease-1.1582526120524 (''Gulf News'')] [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/middle-east/coronavirus-iraq-confirms-first-case (''Straits Times'')] [https://www.foxnews.com/health/afghanistan-first-coronavirus-case-iran (Fox News)]
**[[Spain]] confirms its third case in [[Tenerife]], [[Canary Islands]], from an Italian tourist. [https://www.elperiodico.com/es/sociedad/20200224/coronavirus-china-ultimas-noticias-directo-7817968 (''El Periódico'')]

;International relations
*[[India–United States relations]]
**U.S. President Donald Trump visits India and meets [[Prime Minister of India|Prime Minister]] [[Narendra Modi]] to discuss  the sale of American military jets to India. [https://www.npr.org/2020/02/24/808096104/namaste-trump-india-greets-u-s-leader-with-epic-party-and-modest-policy-aims (NPR)] [https://arynews.tv/en/us-visit-namaste-trump/ (ARY News)]

;Law and crime
*The United States wants the United Kingdom to extradite [[WikiLeaks]] creator [[Julian Assange]], who might face American [[espionage]] charges. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/assange-put-lives-risk-lawyer-u-s-says-extradition-hearing-n1141496 (NBC News)]
*[[Prime Minister of Lesotho]] [[Tom Thabane]] appears in court and hears the charges against him in a pre-trial hearing. He denies involvement in the murder of his former wife and requests immunity from the higher court. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lesotho-politics/lesotho-pm-in-court-on-suspicion-of-murdering-wife-requests-immunity-idUSKCN20I0P7 (Reuters)]
*[[Harvey Weinstein sexual abuse cases]]
**U.S. film producer [[Harvey Weinstein]] is found guilty of rape, and not guilty of predatory sexual assault. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/02/24/nyregion/harvey-weinstein-verdict.html (''The New York Times'')]
*The [[United Kingdom]] bans Sonnenkrieg Division, the UK branch of the American [[Neo-Nazism|Neo-Nazi]] organization [[Atomwaffen Division]], as a terrorist group in response to the [[Hanau shootings]] last week. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2020/feb/24/uk-ban-neo-nazi-sonnenkrieg-division-terrorist-group (''The Guardian'')]
